Android APKs built from [`{tag}`](https://github.com/{repository}/tree/{tag}) of this repository, an Android-focused fork of [isle-portable](https://github.com/isledecomp/isle-portable) by the isledecomp contributors, which is itself a portable version of the [LEGO Island decompilation](https://github.com/isledecomp/isle). This fork is not affiliated with or endorsed by the isledecomp project. LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group, which does not sponsor, authorize or endorse this project.

An existing copy of LEGO Island 1.1 (English) is required. See [installing the Android build](https://github.com/{repository}/blob/{tag}/docs/android-install.md) for which APK to take.

Licensed under the LGPL-3.0; the complete source for these APKs is the tag above. Most of this fork's changes were written with Claude Code, an AI coding assistant, and tested mainly on Android emulators; see the [README](https://github.com/{repository}/blob/{tag}/README.md#ai-disclosure).
